newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Maybank sees rates on hold to year-end.
newsitem.headline: Maybank sees rates on hold to year-end.

text.p: Malayan Banking Bhd (Maybank) said on Saturday it expected domestic interest rates to stay at current levels for the rest of the year.

"The current tight monetary policy of Bank Negara will still be in force due to pressure of inflation. So we feel that the current interest rate level will still continue at least until the end of the year," Maybank managing director Amirsham Abdul Aziz told reporters after the bank's annual meeting.
He said the direction of local interest rates did not reflect overseas trends since the economic scenario in Malaysia was different from that in the United States or Japan.
"Usually the interest rate is one of the monitoring tools used for managing the economy and we have a different set of issues to tackle," Amirsham said.
Malaysia's central bank has regularly intervened in the interbank market to support rates which have been pressured by excess liquidity in the banking system.
